declarations.rationale: Lawyer/attorney/counsel-for, -at and -with form the dominant legal representation family; director is competing contamination.
Chairman, head, executive, chief and president form a genuinely mixed formal-office family. Founder alone does not qualify.
Tell, urge, call on, ask and address dominate; sporting beat and trade are excluded.
Explicit spokesman nominal/appositive paths dominate, ordered spokesperson to represented principal.
Urge and ask alone supply 21 of 53 rows, with tell and testimony reinforcing directed communication. Working together and agreement alone do not qualify.
Send to, submit to, push through and persuade form a submission/communication dictionary. Missing transferred object remains a case-level ambiguity; the predicate is not arbitrary transfer.
Lead, score for, points for, player and guard paths with athlete-to-team roles identify sporting representation. Team-to-team lead is contamination.
President, head, commissioner, commander and director form a mixed formal-office family. Founding and buying alone are excluded.
Based-in and headquarters dominate, ordered organization to location.
Company/firm city modifiers and company-in paths dominate. Geographic role is distinct from national affiliation or industry.
Possessive leader, president and dictator paths with country-to-leader roles dominate. A sports-team president is contamination under this political predicate.
President paths overwhelmingly dominate; borough-president roles establish direction. Manager is not added to the definition.
Review performance, program, production, revival and concert paths relate critics to artistic companies. Venue-only review-at does not by itself establish review of that venue's artistic output.
Editor and editor-in-chief paths dominate over publisher and director. Publishing alone is excluded rather than unioned with editing.
Executive possessive, nominal and executive-of paths dominate; chair/founder alone are excluded.
Chairman, chair and head paths form the dominant leadership family; membership and serving-on alone do not establish chair/head status.
Head-of/head plus chair and lead form the dominant organizational leadership family; founder alone is excluded.
Director-of, possessive director, director-at and director-for dominate; generic performance and head alone do not qualify.
The dictionary mixes competitive trail, beat, game-against and victory paths. Actual competition is the coherent family; standings-only trail or games-behind do not establish an encounter.
Based-in and headquarters paths dominate. National adjective alone is not silently treated as headquarters.
Leave, move-from and move-out-of provide the dominant directional family (18 rows), exceeding return-to/arrive. Destination travel is not unioned into departure.
Center, scorer, scoring goals for, play-with and co-captain paths identify athlete-to-team representation. Bare give and constitutional grants remain outside that assertion.
Country-government/president/leader paths dominate in the inverse political-body-to-person direction; descriptive nationality ambiguity remains visible.
Professor and teach-at form the largest coherent professional family. Analyst, dean and expert alone are not broadened into professorship.
Spokesman and spokeswoman-for dominate; unrelated director/lawyer paths do not qualify automatically.
Possessive/nominal spokesman-appositive paths and say-at spokesmen dominate, ordered institution to spokesperson.
Professor and teach-at form the dominant identifiable profession; expert, specialist, scientist and scholar alone retain their ordinary boundary.
Accuse and criticize provide 10 rows, exceeding the 9-row be-in path. Leadership, presence and alliance are separate competing meanings.
Victory, loss, play and face form a coherent competitive-encounter family with both outcomes represented; winning alone would discard the prominent loss family.
Firm/company based-in and geographic research/firm modifiers dominate in organization-to-location order.
Owner, parent, ownership and own paths dominate in parent/owner-to-asset direction, inverse to subsidiary_of.
Firm nominal city modifiers, based-in and tracker-in dominate. Nationality, industry and individual officeholders remain separate meanings.
Chairman, succeeded-as-chairman, confirmation and resignation paths dominate; executive/president/founder alone are excluded.
Section, neighborhood and district-of paths dominate, with named neighborhoods ordered before their boroughs.
Own, co-owner, own-percent and corporate network paths dominate. Political control is not conflated with ownership.
Ask, speak-with, telephone and call supply a coherent communication family; generic giving remains object-sensitive and meeting alone is excluded.
Lead, head and leader paths dominate; sporting leadership without organizational office and spokesperson status alone are excluded.
Known-as/called/referred-to-as paths overwhelmingly dominate with official-name-to-alias argument roles.

Suffer-from, die-of and have-condition/virus paths identify a coherent disease assertion family, with AIDS/diabetes as objects. Generic have/need athletes is a competing possessive reading, not accepted medical evidence.
Attorney and lawyer nominal/of/for paths dominate. City-modifying attorney requires distinguishing public office from private practice location.
Live-in, living-in and settlement paths dominate; working in, entering or disease claims are not residence.
Play-in, appear-in, event wins/victories and championship paths form the dominant event-participation family, with World Series arguments. Generic geographic presence is distinct.
Chairman paths across apposition, succession, retirement, reappointment and confirmation dominate. Other offices are competing contamination.
Leader, chief, executive, resign-as-executive and office paths collectively form the largest identifiable office family. Travel, sports results and analysis are separate meanings.
Meet-direct-object and meet-with paths dominate. Ordered participants include people and teams; geographic river confluence is not interpersonal/team meeting.
Agency/office part-of paths dominate with child-agency-to-parent-group arguments. Political membership is distinct.
Move-to, leave-for, take-to and relocation dominate in subject-to-destination direction. Sports qualification and future relocation plans are not completed physical travel.
Owner, own, buy and acquisition paths dominate. Suspension from operation alone and geographic destination do not establish ownership.
Based-in, firm-in and consultant-in organization-to-city paths dominate. Personal managerial role and inverse ownership are distinct.
Visit, trip-to and go-to dominate. Work-at or physical residence alone is not travel, and event qualification is distinct.

Dominant son/brother-of constructions have person-to-Manhattan arguments, indicating obituary residence attachment rather than kinship between the two arguments. Unresolved relative attachment must remain ambiguous; nonresidential location is excluded.
Owner nominal/possessive and reign-as-owner paths dominate with sports-owner-to-team roles. Inverse political control and games-at-stadium are separate meanings.
Accuse supplies the strongest identifiable family (8 rows), narrowly ahead of fight/war-with (7). Bordering and political holding are separate meanings; no union predicate is added.
Headquarters-in and based-in dominate, ordered organization to location.
National adjective modifiers of company/giant/conglomerate/electronics/maker dominate; the predicate is nationality affiliation rather than headquarters location.
